# Version 4.151.5
> **RAW decoding retirement** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.5) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.5/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.105/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.5 retires built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use an external RAW decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available. ([#5186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5186))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.105

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
